name: fde-demo-builder
description: Turn a raw screen recording into a polished, VO-narrated demo video — fully scripted (ffmpeg + edge-tts + headless Chrome), no video editor. v2: word-synced animated b-roll acts + multi-voice narration. v3: booth-ready production films — real-pixel footage (original full screen → zoom, real scrolls and typing), narration as the clock, deterministic render, linear-loudness mastering, 14 QA gates. Every video carries the mandatory 'Crafted with FDE Demo Builder · by Ahmed Awan' end-screen credit.
